instructions.name: accept_bid
docs: The owner sells the card to its best bid.

accounts.name: seller
docs: The card's current owner.

instructions.name: admin_burn
docs: Admin, after the notice period: burns the card.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Receives the asset's reclaimed rent.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Pays the seller (minus the listing's fee) and moves the card to the buyer.

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: The seller cancels; anyone can close a listing whose seller no longer
owns the card.

accounts.name: closer
docs: The seller, or anyone once the seller no longer owns the card.

instructions.name: cancel_notice
docs: The owner (or the admin) cancels a notice; anyone can close a stale one.

accounts.name: closer
docs: The owner ("I'm still here"), the admin, or anyone once the card has
changed hands.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup. Only the program's upgrade authority can call it, so
nobody can front-run the deployment and install themselves as admin.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The settlement currency. Must be USDC; the deploy script checks the address.

accounts.name: deployer
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority.

instructions.name: list
docs: Lists a card for sale at `price` USDC minor units. The seller keeps it.

instructions.name: mint_gem
docs: Mints gem `gem_id` to `owner`. Requires the mint authority's signature;
the payer (normally the sponsor) funds rent and fees.

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Escrows `amount` USDC as the card's best bid, refunding any lower bid.

instructions.name: post_notice
docs: Admin: starts the public notice period on a dormant player's card.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of a two-step admin handover, so a typo cannot lock the
program out of its admin powers.

instructions.name: reclaim
docs: Admin, after the notice period: sells the card to its standing best bid,
paying the full amount to the owner.

errors.name: GemAlreadyMinted
errors.msg: This gem has already been minted

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: Signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: InvalidAsset
errors.msg: Account is not a WikiGems card

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: Signer does not own this card

errors.name: StaleListing
errors.msg: The seller no longer owns this card

errors.name: UnexpectedAmount
errors.msg: Price or amount differs from what the signer expected

errors.name: BidTooLow
errors.msg: A new bid must be higher than the current one

errors.name: OwnCard
errors.msg: Owners cannot bid on or buy their own card

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account is not the expected associated token account

errors.name: StaleNotice
errors.msg: The card has changed hands since the notice was posted

errors.name: NoticePeriodActive
errors.msg: The notice period has not elapsed

errors.name: BidTooRecent
errors.msg: The bid is too recent to be used for a reclaim

types.name: Bid
docs: The single best public bid on a card. A higher bid replaces it and refunds
the previous bidder in the same transaction, so this is always the highest
outstanding offer. The USDC sits in the `["bid_vault", asset]` token
account, whose authority is this PDA.

fields.name: amount
docs: USDC minor units (6 decimals).

fields.name: placed_at
docs: When this bidder placed the bid; outbidding resets it.

fields.name: outbid
docs: The bidder who was refunded, if this bid replaced another.

fields.name: admin
docs: Posts dormancy notices, reclaims and burns after the notice period, and
updates config. Intended to become a multisig vault before mainnet.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `propose_admin`; becomes `admin` only when it signs `accept_admin`.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: Online server key that co-signs mints. It cannot move or burn assets.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The only currency the marketplace settles in.

fields.name: treasury
docs: USDC token account that receives marketplace fees.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee on sales and accepted bids, in basis points, capped by `MAX_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Space for later settings without a realloc migration.

types.name: Listing
docs: An escrowless sale offer. The seller keeps the card; `buy` checks the
seller still owns it and settles through the collection's transfer delegate.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC minor units (6 decimals).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee at listing time, so a later fee change cannot surprise the seller.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Receives the account's rent when the listing closes.

types.name: Notice
docs: A public dormancy notice on a card. After `NOTICE_PERIOD_SECONDS`, the
admin can sell the card to its highest bid (all proceeds to the owner) or
burn it. The owner cancels it with one signature, and it is void as soon as
the card changes hands.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner when the notice was posted.

fields.name: actionable_at
docs: Earliest time of a reclaim or burn.

fields.name: amount
docs: Paid in full to the former owner; reclaims carry no fee.
